about: Fastighets AB Balder (publ) owns, manages, and develops properties in Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Norway, Germany, and the United Kingdom. Its property portfolio comprises offices, shops, warehouses, restaurants, schools, and others, as well as hotel properties. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden.
